rationale: C23 is the proposal to which the child directly responds and supplies both its operative framework and distinctive language: continued steel operations, appointment of an investigatory board, presentation of the dispute, a sixty-day period, and recommendations for fair and equitable settlement terms. The child adapts that proposal into replies addressing the companies' objections and acceptances. C10 and C12 concern comparable boards under section 206, but their statutory emergency machinery is materially different from the nonbinding board described in the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I trust that you will cooperate in presenting the full facts to the board I am appointing.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am appointing a Board consisting of three public members to investigate and to inquire into the issues in dispute
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same newly appointed board as the mechanism for examining the steel dispute.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board I am appointing will make recommendations as to fair and equitable terms of settlement.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: with their recommendations to the parties as to fair and equitable terms of settlement
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive, nearly verbatim language describing the board's intended product.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I interpret it to mean that you plan to continue operations and that you will present your side of dispute to the board I am appointing
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am requesting the parties to continue work and operations ... I am appointing a Board ... to investigate and to inquire into the issues in dispute
shared_material.explanation: The child converts the parent's two-part proposal—continued operations plus board inquiry—into an interpretation of the recipients' acceptance.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hope and believe final agreement can be reached within the sixty day period.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: for a period of sixty days from July 16, 1949
shared_material.explanation: The child's unexplained sixty-day period directly refers to the duration established in C23.
